references.text: Parallel account where God commands the Israelites to turn and head toward the wilderness in the direction of the Red Sea after they refused to enter the Promised Land
The Israelites travel from Mount Hor by the road to the Red Sea, mentioning the same route through the wilderness
Describes the wilderness by the Red Sea (Sea of Reeds) as a route the Israelites followed after leaving Egypt
Moses repeats that they turned and headed toward the wilderness in the direction of the Red Sea, just as the Lord had commanded
Part of the travel route describing the Israelites' journey by the Red Sea and through the Wilderness of Sin
